testcase.name: Given a proto with an identifier that is not a UUID, when I isInvalid, then I expect true
Given a proto with a deletion timestamp, when I isInvalid, then I expect false
Given a proto with a visible name, when I isInvalid, then I expect false
Given a proto without a name, when I isInvalid, then I expect false
Given a proto that is MyStory with a deletion timestamp, when I isInvalid, then I expect true
Given a validated proto that is MyStory, when I isInvalid with another MyStory, then I expect true
Given a proto without a name or deletion timestamp, when I isInvalid, then I expect true
Given a proto without a visible name, when I isInvalid, then I expect true
Given a proto without an identifier, when I isInvalid, then I expect true
